summary: A 5,000 neuron stand in for the fly brain with realistic circuit layout (vision, smell, memory, navigation, escape) and invented numbers. Fast enough to experiment with in the browser.
citations: Circuit layout inspired by: Dorkenwald, S. et al. (2024). Neuronal wiring diagram of an adult brain. Nature 634, 124-138.
Simulation parameters from: Shiu, P. K. et al. (2024). A Drosophila computational brain model reveals sensorimotor processing. Nature 634, 210-219.
caveats: Synthetic data. Cell type names are real, the wiring numbers are invented.
Use the FlyWire importer to run the same experiments on the real brain.

readouts.label: Escape take off
readouts.description: Firing of the Giant Fiber, the neuron that triggers the jump.

readouts.label: Steering
readouts.description: Right minus left DNa02, the descending neurons that steer walking.

readouts.label: Backward walking
readouts.description: Firing of the moonwalker descending neurons (MDN).

presets.label: Looming object
presets.description: Something approaches fast from the right. Stimulate the looming detectors LC4 and LPLC2.
presets.expected: Giant Fiber fires, the fly escapes

presets.label: Looming without LPLC2
presets.description: Same threat, but LPLC2 neurons are silenced.

presets.label: Smell an odour
presets.description: Stimulate olfactory receptor neurons (ORN) and watch memory output neurons (MBON).

presets.label: Kick the compass
presets.description: Stimulate the central complex compass neurons (EPG) on the right.
presets.expected: a steering bias through PFL3 and DNa02
